title: dtoa markup or new license (OAR license)
body:
During Fedora license review in https://gitlab.com/fedora/legal/fedora-license-data/-/issues/488
we discovered the license in package newlib
https://sourceware.org/git/?p=newlib-cygwin.git;a=blob;f=newlib/libc/string/strsignal.c;hb=HEAD

Text of the license:
```
*  COPYRIGHT (c) 1989-2013, 2015.
 *  On-Line Applications Research Corporation (OAR).
 *
 *  Permission to use, copy, modify, and distribute this software for any
 *  purpose without fee is hereby granted, provided that this entire notice
 *  is included in all copies of any software which is or includes a copy
 *  or modification of this software.
 *
 *  THIS SOFTWARE IS BEING PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT ANY EXPRESS OR IMPLIED
 *  WARRANTY.  IN PARTICULAR,  THE AUTHOR MAKES NO REPRESENTATION
 *  OR WARRANTY OF ANY KIND CONCERNING THE MERCHANTABILITY OF THIS
 *  SOFTWARE OR ITS FITNESS FOR ANY PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
```

The wording is very similar to `dtoa` license.  With two changes:

1) in fist paragraph is omitted the trailing of the paragraph: "and in all copies of the supporting
documentation for such software".

2)  In the second paragraph are committed words NEITHER, NOR LUCENT and instead of ANY is used NO.

Is this a new license? Or should it be handled by markup change to dtoa?
